text: This is a  nice curtain. It helps to block the light. Color name the same as pictured.. This blocks light  really well.  The print is nice and the curtain is well made.  It's easy to use.  Using the ties, you can raise the curtain "shade" easily and it looks cute.  The yellow color isn't as bright as in the photo. It's more of a golden yellow. I don't really like it.  I do like the curtain itself, just not the color.

product_metadata.title: DriftAway Amelia Retro Geo Pattern Round Circle Star Print Blackout Tie Up Adjustable Balloon Rod Pocket Curtain Single Each 45 Inch by 63 Inch Yellow
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: Single tie up curtain. Extremely soft to touch. Made of 100% polyester, imported.
UPGRADED VERSION: These circular geometric print drapes provide a modern elegant look, will be perfect for living room, bedroom, dining room and nursery room.

EASY ADJUST & SERVE WELL: It is easy to adjust to the height per your need for shading and privacy protection, feature high performance on light reducing, thermal insulated, noise reducing, energy saving / efficiency and privacy protection. Perfect for small window of home, kitchen, breakfast room, bathroom, living room and bedroom
SIZE & HEADER TYPE: 45”W X 63”L. 3” Rod pocket construction slides easily onto your curtain rod for quick installation.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle in a mesh bag, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry low, iron on a cool setting.
